newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Soros funds acquire 20 pct of Sudamtex -bolsa.
newsitem.headline: Soros funds acquire 20 pct of Sudamtex -bolsa.

text.p: A group of funds managed by New York-based financial guru George Soros has acquired at least a 20 percent stake in Venezuelan textiles company Sudamtex , the stock market said.

A note circulated to brokers by the bolsa's information system said: "Sudamtex's Executive Board has been informed that a group of funds controlled by the Soros Group has bought in the market 3.45 million of the company's American Depository Receipts, equivalent to 138 million underlying Class B shares."
Class B stock off 1.15 bolivars at 39.60 at midday, but has steadily firmed from 32.00 bolivars over the past two weeks.
